name: Ueki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ueki town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom with a small pointed stroke at the top.
history: Flag of the former town of Ueki in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-03-23. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1980.

features.role: Ueki town emblem — a ring open at the bottom with a small pointed stroke at the top
